slot2_dispatch_proof.conclusion: For an actual BridgeAssetBundle receiver, EncrypterBundle interface slot 2 resolves to non-generic BridgeAssetBundle.LoadAssetAsync method ID76228 at VA0x181433c90.
slot2_dispatch_proof.runtime_receiver_requirement: The method-table mapping does not itself establish the allocated receiver; combine with original TypeInfo allocation usage and parent REA data-flow.

decoding_rules.type_definition_layout: <16i8H2I, 88 bytes; interfacesStart/raw[13], vtableStart/raw[14], interfaceOffsetsStart/raw[15], vtableCount/raw[21], interfacesCount/raw[22], interfaceOffsetsCount/raw[23]
decoding_rules.decoded_index: (raw & 0x1fffffff) >> 1 for this v31 build; the low bit is discarded
decoding_rules.vtable_method_index: For usage kind3=MethodDef, decoded_index is the global method-definition index; kind6=MethodRef is a method-spec index and is not decoded as MethodDef.
decoding_rules.parser_evidence: Shipped LibCpp2IL.Il2CppTypeDefinition get_VTable lambda calls MetadataUsage.DecodeMetadataUsage, whose IL shifts the low 29-bit value right one for MetadataVersion>=27. GetDecodedMethodIndex alone masks but does not shift and is not substituted for that vtable path.
decoding_rules.interface_offset: Concrete class slot = interfaceOffsets.offset + declared interface method slot; stored offset is in vtable entries, not bytes.
